description: Add, remove or replace one participant's available calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD, today up to two years ahead). Do not call this tool when the user says they are under 13 (or a known higher local minimum), even with a nickname: explain that lesgooo is not available to them. Do not write another known underage child's personal data, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, IDs, passwords or verification codes. Offer ordinary non-sensitive planning text instead; do not replace a restricted request with an unrequested plan.

mode.description: replace sets the entire list; add and remove change only the supplied dates. Default: replace.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

name: set_availability
title: Set available days
